name: Prince and the Demon Maid
source:
Gaven is a prince madly in love with his maid, Roxanne. Unfortunately, he's also extremely shy and has never been able to confess his feelings to her. It doesn't help that they belong to different social classes or that she's older than him.

Then, one day, his father reveals that Roxanne is a demon summoned to keep their family in power, shattering Gaven's entire worldview.

Are demons really as evil as the stories say? Does Roxanne care about him only because of her contract with the family? And is she even the person he fell in love with?

[From [url=https://ukigumosama.itch.io/prince-and-the-demon-maid]itch.io[/url]]
